1/13

dev here. i want to properly explain what i’m building with Nibbelt because it is much more than a character connected to a GitHub account.

Nibbelt is a small autonomous agent that starts with almost nothing and has to build itself into something useful.

2/13

most agents launch with every tool, permission and ability already handed to them.

Nibbelt starts weak on purpose.

it receives a workspace, a wallet, a memory and a small set of tools. everything after that has to come from actual work completed by the agent.

3/13

the growth is not based on pressing a button or watching a fake level number increase.

Nibbelt grows by writing code, solving issues, creating new skills, passing tests and making real commits to its own GitHub repository.

the repo is basically its life unfolding in public.

4/13

i used OpenClaw 2.0 as the runtime underneath Nibbelt.

OpenClaw is not the personality or intelligence itself. it is closer to the nervous system keeping the agent alive... Show more
